subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Welcome to the thread — I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on the discovery we ran through. High-level recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Goal: pilot Redwood Inference for secure clinical-notes summarization across 3 sites (baseline throughput ~10 reqs/sec).
- Success metrics: 95% SLA for 95th percentile latency < 600ms; token cost target <$0.002/token in production; integration with their VPC and KMS required.
- Key stakeholders: Lisa (Clinical), Tom (IT/Procurement), Raj Patel (Security), Procurement team (contract).

Attached MAP highlights (see attached PDF):
- Milestone 1 (POC kickoff): Redwood provides sandbox environment + onboarding guide. Owner: Redwood (Marissa + Connor). Target: 2026-05-10.
- Milestone 2 (Security review & evidence): Provide SOC2 artifacts, architecture diagram, and keystore docs. Owner: Acme (Tom / Raj). Target: 2026-05-24.
- Milestone 3 (Integration & pilot): VPC peering, test dataset ingestion, pilot run. Owner: joint (Acme infra + Redwood eng). Target: 2026-06-14.
- Milestone 4 (Contract + Go-Live): SOW signed, reserved capacity provisioning. Owner: Procurement + Redwood Sales. Target close: 2026-06-30.

Open dependencies:
- Procurement approval cycle (Tom to confirm exact approvers and timeline).
- Security checklist completion (Raj).
- Data access and anonymization sign-off from Clinical (Lisa).

Ask: Could you please review the attached MAP ("Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf") and confirm: 1) if targets/dates look reasonable, 2) who owns the security artifact delivery, and 3) whether Procurement has any blackout dates in May/June?

If that works, I'll update the MAP and share a versioned plan we can keep current as dates change.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (23KB)]

From: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Acme Healthcare Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare

Marissa — thanks for the recap and draft MAP. Lisa and I reviewed it internally. A couple of updates from our side:

1) Procurement timeline shift — our Q3 procurement window just moved due to a budget review. We now expect Procurement sign-off around mid-August rather than June. Proposed reforecast target close: 2026-08-15.

2) Security gating — Raj flagged that getting SOC2 evidence and encryption confirmation will take longer than expected (internal approvals required). Likely completion: end of May.

3) Prioritization ask — Clinical needs the pilot data ingest and basic validation earlier for clinical workflow testing, but they are OK with a reduced-scope pilot (no reserved capacity) to get results faster. Can we split Milestone 3 into: 3a (reduced-scope pilot — target 2026-05-28) and 3b (full integration — tied to contract close)?

4) Procurement asked whether we can cap initial committed spend under an MSA while the SOW finalizes — they prefer a short-term trial commitment.

Would you be able to revise the MAP to reflect the new close date and split milestone 3 into 3a/3b? Also cc'ing Procurement so we can loop in the right approvers for contract language.

Thanks,
Tom
IT Program Manager | Acme Healthcare

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Acme Healthcare Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare

Tom / Lisa — appreciate the quick review and the transparency on the procurement window. I've updated the MAP to reflect your asks and split the integration milestone as requested. Summary of changes below and attached updated MAP (v2).

Updated MAP summary (high level):
- New target close: 2026-08-15 (deal_id RW-ACME-2026-042).
- Milestone 1: POC kickoff (unchanged) — Target: 2026-05-10. Owner: Redwood (Marissa / Connor).
- Milestone 2: Security & evidence delivery — Target: 2026-05-31 (Acme owner: Raj/Tom).
- Milestone 3a: Reduced-scope pilot (data ingest + validation, no reserved capacity) — Target: 2026-05-28. Owner: joint.
- Milestone 3b: Full integration & pilot (reserved capacity, performance tuning) — Tentative target: 2026-07-20, contingent on contract.
- Milestone 4: Contract execution & provisioning — Target close: 2026-08-15. Owner: Procurement + Redwood Sales.

Contract flexibility: We can support a short-term trial commitment under the MSA to allow clinical testing while Procurement completes SOW approvals. Connor / Aditya, can you please confirm the proposed trial cap and estimated cost for a 6-week reduced-scope pilot so I can include that in the MAP?

Risks / blockers:
- Procurement blackout dates in June (Tom, please confirm specific dates).
- Security evidence timing — if SOC2 artifacts slip beyond end of May, the full integration (3b) will shift further.

Next steps:
1) Connor & Aditya — estimate trial cap numbers and add to MAP (Connor by 4/15).
2) Tom / Raj — confirm security owner and procurement approver list (Tom by 4/16).
3) I'll circulate Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf and update HubSpot (link below).

Thanks all — looping Rachel (CS) for onboarding notes post-contract.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (28KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare (internal summary)

Team — internal summary (pulling from the thread above):

1) Customer reforecasted target close to 2026-08-15 due to Procurement calendar shift. Priority is getting a reduced-scope pilot in May so Clinical can validate results.

2) Action items for us:
- Connor: produce trial cap and estimated cost for a 6-week reduced-scope pilot (due EOD 2026-04-15). Include expected infra usage and token cost assumptions.
- Aditya: prepare a proposed MSA amendment language that supports short-term trial commitment and limited spend while SOW finalizes.
- Rachel: draft a high-level onboarding checklist for the reduced-scope pilot (data prep requirements, test dataset guidelines, success criteria).

3) Risks to call out on next exec sync: SOC2 evidence timing could push full integration; we should propose an interim fallback (e.g., scoped pilot under Redwood-hosted sandbox with synthetic data) if Acme can't deliver evidence.

I've already sent Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2 to the customer and updated the HubSpot link. I'll keep you posted on Procurement approver list.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
